title: The Paradise Mumbai press meet: Nani calls Baazigar his “favourite commercial film”; reveals, “Shah Rukh Khan and I have the EXACT same measurements; wish we had the same PAYMENT as well!” : Bollywood News
content:
Natural Star Nani, as he is fondly known, brought his characteristic charm and candour to the promotional event for "The Paradise Mumbai," the Hindi dubbed version of his critically acclaimed Telugu film *Hi Nanna*. Addressing a packed house of journalists and media personnel, Nani's admiration for Shah Rukh Khan took centre stage. His declaration of *Baazigar* as his top commercial film resonated deeply, underscoring the enduring appeal of the Bollywood classic and Shah Rukh Khan's impactful performance that cemented his status as a leading man with a penchant for complex roles. The actor's heartfelt appreciation set a warm tone for the interaction, showcasing the camaraderie and mutual respect that often transcend regional film boundaries.

Nani's journey in Indian cinema has seen him evolve into a formidable pan-India presence, much like many of his contemporaries from the South. His films, initially gaining immense popularity in the Telugu-speaking states, are now increasingly finding audiences across the country through dubbed releases and streaming platforms. This expanding reach positions him as a significant voice within the broader national film landscape. Shah Rukh Khan, on the other hand, remains an undisputed global icon, whose filmography, including *Baazigar*, continues to inspire generations of actors and filmmakers, making Nani's specific choice a poignant nod to a cinematic milestone.

The highlight of the press meet, however, was Nani's playful yet pointed comparison with Shah Rukh Khan regarding their physical measurements and, more significantly, their remuneration. The comment, "Shah Rukh Khan and I have the EXACT same measurements; wish we had the same PAYMENT as well!" elicited laughter and applause, effectively conveying a deeper sentiment about the economic realities and pay structures within the vast Indian film industry. While delivered with wit, the remark subtly touched upon the aspirations of many actors to achieve the financial stature commensurate with their talent and growing national appeal, particularly for those transitioning from regional industries to the pan-Indian stage.

Industry observers and film analysts have frequently pointed out the evolving landscape of star remuneration, especially with the rise of pan-Indian cinema. Nani's comment, while light-hearted, provides an interesting lens into this discussion. It reflects not just a fan's admiration but also a confident statement from an actor who is steadily building his brand beyond his home turf. Such cross-industry comparisons, particularly from a respected actor like Nani, often spark conversations about talent valuation, market reach, and the eventual convergence of pay scales as the lines between "Bollywood" and "South Indian cinema" continue to blur. It also generates significant buzz, effectively amplifying the promotional efforts for his film.

Nani's engaging interaction at "The Paradise Mumbai" press meet serves as a testament to his growing confidence and charisma on a national platform. His ability to connect with the Hindi-speaking media through humour and genuine admiration for a Bollywood stalwart like Shah Rukh Khan undoubtedly aids in expanding the reach of his film. As South Indian films continue to dominate box office collections and critical discourse across India, such witty and insightful remarks from prominent actors like Nani not only entertain but also contribute to a more open dialogue about the industry's dynamics and the aspirations of its diverse talents.

Ultimately, Nani's comments at the "The Paradise Mumbai" press meet were more than just soundbites; they were a blend of fanboy enthusiasm, sharp wit, and a subtle commentary on the industry's economic realities. As "The Paradise Mumbai" (Hi Nanna) prepares for its wider release, Nani's memorable interaction has certainly added a personal touch to its promotion, further cementing his image as an accessible yet aspirational star. His ability to charm and articulate complex sentiments with ease ensures that he remains a compelling figure in the ever-evolving narrative of Indian cinema.

title: Rashmika Mandanna to join Michael B. Jordan, Dakota Johnson, Dua Lipa and Irina Shayk on Vogue World Milan red carpet
content:
Rashmika Mandanna, a prominent figure in Indian cinema, is poised to elevate her international presence by participating in the highly anticipated Vogue World Milan. The event will see her share the red carpet with a constellation of global stars, including the critically acclaimed actor Michael B. Jordan, Hollywood darling Dakota Johnson, pop superstar Dua Lipa, and fashion icon Irina Shayk. This announcement has generated considerable buzz, highlighting Mandanna's burgeoning appeal beyond the Indian subcontinent and firmly placing her in the echelon of international celebrities recognized for their style and influence. Her attendance at such a prestigious gathering signifies a major step in bridging the gap between Indian entertainment and the global fashion elite.

Vogue World, an ambitious annual spectacle launched by *Vogue* magazine, serves as a dynamic celebration of fashion, culture, and entertainment, typically featuring a blend of runway shows, live performances, and exclusive celebrity appearances. Previous editions in New York and London have set a high bar, bringing together the biggest names in fashion and Hollywood. Hosting the event in Milan, one of the world's undisputed fashion capitals, adds an extra layer of prestige and underscores its importance in the global style calendar. Rashmika Mandanna’s journey from a beloved South Indian actress to a pan-Indian sensation with films like *Pushpa: The Rise* has now culminated in this significant international foray, reflecting her growing stature and appeal across diverse audiences.

The red carpet at Vogue World is far more than a mere photo opportunity; it is a meticulously curated display of high fashion, designer collaborations, and celebrity styling that commands global attention. Mandanna's presence alongside A-listers like Michael B. Jordan, known for his sartorial elegance, and Dakota Johnson, a muse for many high-fashion brands, places her squarely in the global fashion spotlight. Her choice of attire for the evening is expected to be a major talking point, potentially featuring an ensemble from a renowned international designer, further cementing her status as a style influencer. This appearance is also a testament to her expanding portfolio of fashion endorsements and her consistent presence at high-profile industry events.

According to renowned fashion critic and cultural commentator, Anjali Sharma, Mandanna’s invitation to Vogue World Milan is a strategic move that reflects broader shifts in the global fashion landscape. "This isn't just about one actress; it's about the increasing recognition of the Indian market and the immense talent pool within Indian cinema," Sharma explains. "Rashmika's inclusion alongside such diverse international figures speaks volumes about her cross-cultural appeal and the breaking down of geographical barriers in fashion and entertainment. It offers a fresh perspective, bridging Bollywood glamour with high European fashion, and undoubtedly elevates her personal brand on a global scale." This move also highlights how Indian celebrities are increasingly being sought after for their unique blend of cultural heritage and modern appeal.

Mandanna’s participation is poised to have significant implications for her career and for Indian representation on international platforms. Such an event serves as a powerful springboard for future international collaborations, whether in film, fashion, or brand endorsements, opening doors to a global audience and industry stakeholders. It underscores a growing trend where Indian stars are not just attending but actively contributing to global cultural narratives, moving beyond traditional film circuits. The media coverage and social media engagement surrounding her appearance will undoubtedly amplify her visibility, solidifying her position as a truly global icon and inspiring other Indian talents to aspire to similar international recognition.

Ultimately, Rashmika Mandanna’s confirmed appearance at Vogue World Milan marks a momentous occasion, not only for her individual career but also for the broader narrative of Indian talent gaining prominence on the world stage. Her inclusion among such a distinguished cohort of international celebrities is a clear indicator of her growing influence and the increasing global appeal of Indian culture and entertainment. As the event draws closer, anticipation builds for what promises to be a spectacular display of fashion, talent, and cross-cultural exchange, further cementing Mandanna’s status as a formidable presence in the global entertainment and fashion industries.

title: Mikel Arteta ‘agrees new contract’ as head coach of Arsenal
content:
Reports circulating widely across football media suggest that Mikel Arteta has committed his long-term future to Arsenal, agreeing to a new deal that will see him remain at the helm beyond his current contract, which was set to expire in 2025. While Arsenal Football Club has yet to make an official announcement, the news, initially reported by outlets like players.bio, has been met with significant excitement among the fanbase and within football circles. This reported agreement underscores the club's determination to maintain the continuity and momentum built under Arteta’s stewardship, following two consecutive seasons of formidable Premier League title challenges.

Arteta’s journey at Arsenal has been one of significant transformation since he took over in December 2019. Initially arriving as head coach after a stint as assistant manager at Manchester City, he inherited a club in disarray, struggling for identity and consistent performance. Despite early challenges and a period of rebuilding, his clear philosophy, tactical acumen, and strong leadership saw the club win the FA Cup in his first season. More importantly, he has meticulously reshaped the squad, fostering a vibrant team culture, promoting youth, and instilling a winning mentality that has propelled Arsenal back to the pinnacle of English football.

The specifics of the reported contract are still emerging, but sources indicate it is a multi-year extension, potentially tying Arteta to the Emirates Stadium until 2029 or even beyond, complete with improved financial terms reflecting his elevated status and achievements. This timing is particularly significant, coming off the back of a season where Arsenal pushed champions Manchester City to the final day in the Premier League title race, and amidst lingering speculation linking Arteta to high-profile managerial vacancies at clubs like Barcelona and Real Madrid. Securing his commitment is not just about retaining a manager, but about safeguarding the entire project he has meticulously crafted, ensuring a stable foundation for ongoing player development and recruitment strategies.

Football pundits and analysts have largely lauded the reported extension, highlighting the critical importance of continuity in modern football. Jamie Carragher, a prominent Sky Sports pundit, has often spoken about the need for clubs to back their managers over long periods to see true success, a sentiment echoed by many who view Arteta's contract as a testament to Arsenal's long-term vision. Securing Arteta's future is seen as equally, if not more, crucial than signing a marquee player, as it provides clarity and confidence for potential new signings and reinforces the club's ambition to return to consistent trophy contention, particularly in the Champions League.

The implications of this agreement are far-reaching for Arsenal. With their head coach's future secured, the club can approach the upcoming summer transfer window with renewed confidence and a clear strategic direction, making them a more attractive destination for top-tier talent. It signals to both current players and potential recruits that Arsenal is a club with a defined project and a stable environment, aiming for sustained success at the highest level. This stability is paramount as Arsenal seeks to bridge the final gap to silverware, ensuring the club can continue its upward trajectory and consolidate its place among Europe's elite footballing institutions for years to come.

title: China's Z.ai disables AI coding assistant features after security issue
content:
The Chinese technology firm, Z.ai, announced it had temporarily suspended core functionalities of its AI coding assistant, including auto-completion, code generation, and debugging suggestions, effective immediately. This decisive move was taken after internal investigations revealed a potential security flaw that could compromise user data or expose proprietary code. While Z.ai has not yet disclosed the specific nature of the vulnerability, the swift disabling of features suggests a serious threat requiring immediate mitigation to protect its user base of developers and enterprises.

AI coding assistants have become indispensable tools for many software developers, promising to accelerate development cycles and enhance productivity by automating repetitive tasks and suggesting optimal code solutions. Companies like Z.ai are at the forefront of this innovation, leveraging large language models to understand context and generate human-like code. However, the very nature of these tools, which process and learn from vast amounts of code, introduces complex security considerations, including the risk of data leakage, intellectual property exposure, or even the inadvertent injection of malicious code.

Security experts are watching the Z.ai incident closely, viewing it as a significant cautionary tale for the burgeoning AI development sector. Dr. Li Wei, a prominent cybersecurity researcher based in Beijing, commented, "This incident with Z.ai serves as a stark reminder that while AI offers immense potential for productivity, it also introduces novel vectors for security vulnerabilities. The reliance on large datasets and intricate algorithms means that even a minor flaw can have widespread implications, potentially exposing sensitive corporate data or proprietary algorithms to unauthorized access." He further emphasized the need for rigorous security audits and ethical AI development practices.

For Z.ai's users, the immediate consequence is a disruption to their workflow and a potential slowdown in development projects that relied heavily on the AI assistant's capabilities. More broadly, this event is likely to prompt increased scrutiny across the industry, pushing developers and providers of AI coding tools to prioritize robust security frameworks from conception. It also raises questions about the regulatory landscape for AI tools, particularly concerning data privacy and intellectual property protection in an era where AI models are trained on and interact with highly sensitive information.

As Z.ai continues its investigation and works towards a resolution, the incident underscores the delicate balance between innovation and security in the AI era. Companies are under immense pressure to deliver cutting-edge AI solutions, but this must not come at the expense of user trust and data integrity. The coming months will likely see Z.ai not only patching its systems but also communicating transparently with its users and the wider industry, setting a precedent for how AI firms address and recover from significant security challenges.

title: School Assembly News Today, September 22, 2026: Top Headlines, Thought, Word & History
content:
The tradition of the morning assembly remains a cornerstone of holistic education in India, providing a vital space for collective learning and community building before the academic day commences. On Tuesday, September 22, 2026, schools across the nation upheld this practice, delivering a carefully curated digest of information designed to broaden students' perspectives. These sessions are meticulously planned to not only keep students abreast of global and local happenings but also to instill ethical values and a sense of historical consciousness, shaping them into well-rounded individuals.

This morning's assembly prominently featured top headlines that resonated with both national aspirations and global progress. Nationally, the successful launch of "Digital India 2.0," a government initiative aimed at integrating advanced AI literacy into the secondary school curriculum by 2030, garnered significant attention, promising a future-ready workforce. Internationally, news of a groundbreaking advancement in sustainable fusion energy technology from a collaborative European-Asian research consortium dominated headlines, heralding a potential paradigm shift in global energy production and climate action. These developments highlight humanity's relentless pursuit of innovation and sustainable growth.

Beyond factual reporting, the assembly delved into character building with its "Thought for the Day" and "Word of the Day" segments. The thought, "Our collective future is built on shared responsibility and empathetic action," urged students to consider their role in community and global well-being, emphasizing the power of unity and compassion. Complementing this, the "Word of the Day" was "Synergy," defined as the interaction or cooperation of two or more organizations, substances, or other agents to produce a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects. This selection encouraged students to understand the value of collaboration and teamwork in achieving common goals, both in their academic lives and future careers.

A crucial segment of the assembly was dedicated to history, commemorating the 61st anniversary of the ceasefire that concluded the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965 on September 22. Students were reminded of the intense conflict and the subsequent diplomatic efforts that led to the cessation of hostilities, underscoring the complexities of international relations and the enduring quest for peace in the subcontinent. This historical reflection served as a poignant reminder of the sacrifices made and the imperative for dialogue and peaceful resolution in addressing geopolitical challenges, offering valuable lessons for future generations on diplomacy and conflict prevention.

Educationists and historians frequently emphasize the profound impact of such integrated assembly programs. Dr. Anjali Sharma, a renowned educational psychologist, notes that "daily assemblies act as micro-universities, offering a holistic curriculum that extends beyond textbooks, fostering critical thinking, empathy, and civic responsibility." Similarly, Professor Rajeev Malhotra, a historian specializing in South Asian conflicts, states, "Contextualizing historical events like the 1965 ceasefire within current affairs helps students understand the long arc of history and its relevance to contemporary challenges, making them more informed global citizens." These expert opinions reinforce the enduring value of these morning rituals in nurturing well-informed and ethically grounded individuals.

Ultimately, the school assembly on September 22, 2026, exemplified its enduring role as a vital educational tool, transcending mere announcements to offer a rich tapestry of knowledge and values. By seamlessly weaving together national and international news, reflective thoughts, vocabulary enrichment, and historical insights, these daily gatherings empower students with a broader understanding of the world and their place within it. They serve as a powerful reminder that education is not just about academic achievement but also about fostering responsible citizens who are aware, engaged, and prepared to contribute positively to society, embodying the spirit of continuous learning and growth.

title: Posh hotel office, private chopper, a ‘diplomat’: How Delhi firm pitched ‘Indo-US’ scam
content:
Delhi Police’s Economic Offences Wing (EOW) has busted a multi-crore investment scam, arresting Vinod Kumar Singh and Vineet Kumar Singh, directors of VPVV Techno Construction Pvt Ltd. The duo stands accused of orchestrating an elaborate fraud, enticing investors with promises of exorbitant monthly returns, ranging from 3% to 5%, on investments in ambitious but entirely fictitious "Indo-US infrastructure projects." This scheme, which preyed on the aspirations of high returns, has reportedly defrauded numerous individuals, including retired government officials and seasoned businessmen, of substantial sums, running into several crores of rupees.

The modus operandi of VPVV Techno Construction was characterized by its audacious and meticulously crafted facade of legitimacy and exclusivity. To project an image of immense wealth and influence, the firm operated its primary office from the opulent confines of The Leela Palace, a five-star hotel in Chanakyapuri. Potential high-net-worth investors were further swayed by being offered private helicopter rides, ostensibly to showcase vast project sites, reinforcing the impression of a large-scale, legitimate operation. A crucial element of their deception involved introducing an individual who would pose as a high-ranking diplomat or government official, sometimes claiming connections to the US Embassy or the Ministry of External Affairs, lending an air of official endorsement to their spurious ventures.

Beyond the luxurious settings and fabricated personnel, the perpetrators bolstered their illusion with a trove of forged documents, Memorandum of Understanding (MOUs), and professionally designed presentations. These materials falsely depicted partnerships with prominent US firms and purported involvement in significant government infrastructure projects, lending a veneer of credibility to their operations. Investors were even taken on "tours" of alleged project sites, which were in reality either vacant plots of land or existing government projects with which VPVV Techno Construction had absolutely no affiliation. This systematic layering of deception ensured that victims genuinely believed they were investing in a secure and highly profitable enterprise.

Financial experts and law enforcement officials often highlight how such elaborate scams exploit fundamental human vulnerabilities: the desire for quick wealth and the inherent trust placed in symbols of power and luxury. "Fraudsters are increasingly sophisticated, using psychological manipulation to bypass critical thinking," commented a financial analyst familiar with such cases. "The use of five-star hotels, private jets, and 'diplomats' isn't just about showing off; it's about creating an impenetrable bubble of perceived credibility that discourages due diligence." This sentiment underscores the critical importance for investors to conduct thorough background checks and be wary of any investment promising returns significantly higher than market averages, regardless of the perceived prestige of the source.

The unearthing of this elaborate fraud by the EOW carries significant implications for investor confidence and serves as a stark reminder of the persistent threat of financial scams. The police investigation is currently focused on meticulously tracing the money trail, identifying all beneficiaries of the ill-gotten gains, and locating additional victims who may have been too embarrassed or unaware to come forward. Recovering the defrauded funds presents a substantial challenge, often complicated by the swift dissipation of assets and the use of shell companies. This case further emphasizes the need for robust regulatory oversight and public awareness campaigns to educate potential investors about the red flags associated with high-yield investment schemes.

The audacity and intricate planning behind the VPVV Techno Construction scam underscore a worrying trend in financial fraud, where elaborate facades are constructed to ensnare unsuspecting investors. While the arrests of the directors are a significant step, the full extent of the network and the total amount defrauded are still under investigation. This incident serves as a crucial cautionary tale, urging individuals to exercise extreme caution and conduct rigorous due diligence before committing funds to any investment opportunity, particularly those promising extraordinary returns and operating under a veil of exclusivity and high-profile connections. Law enforcement remains committed to dismantling such criminal enterprises and protecting the financial integrity of the nation.
